text: {"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:1:moved-import", "app/settings.py:10:config-class"], "search": "from pydantic import BaseSettings, Field", "replace": "from pydantic import ConfigDict, Field\nfrom pydantic_settings import BaseSettings", "explanation": "BaseSettings moved out of pydantic in v2 and now lives in the pydantic-settings package, so it is imported from there. ConfigDict is added to the pydantic import because the class Config block is replaced with model_config = ConfigDict(...). Field stays imported from pydantic."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:7:field-kwargs"], "search": "    database_url: str = Field(\"sqlite:///local.db\", env=\"INVENTORY_DB_URL\")", "replace": "    database_url: str = Field(\"sqlite:///local.db\", validation_alias=\"INVENTORY_DB_URL\")", "explanation": "The `env` keyword argument to Field was removed in pydantic v2 (and pydantic-settings). Per the pydantic-settings docs, validation_alias sets the environment variable name the field reads from. The alias is used verbatim and the env_prefix is not applied to an explicit alias, so the same INVENTORY_DB_URL variable is still read and behavior is preserved."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/settings.py:10:config-class"], "search": "    class Config:\n        env_prefix = \"INVENTORY_\"", "replace": "    model_config = ConfigDict(env_prefix=\"INVENTORY_\")", "explanation": "The inner `class Config` is deprecated in pydantic v2 in favor of `model_config = ConfigDict(...)`. The key env_prefix is unchanged, so the prefix behavior is identical."}], "notes": "Three edits cover all three findings, and none overlap. The import edit also adds ConfigDict, which the config edit needs. Field(env=...) becomes validation_alias=\"INVENTORY_DB_URL\". Because an explicit alias is used verbatim, the env_prefix does not apply to it, so the variable read stays INVENTORY_DB_URL. Nothing else in the file was changed. Assumes pydantic-settings is installed, as stated in the task. No documentation was retrieved, so the citations rely on the standard v2 and pydantic-settings behavior."}
